positions.title: Travel
positions.description: I took time off to travel and live around the world while pursuing personal and professional development goals. I took full-stack development classes in Malaysia, became a certified open water scuba diver in the Philippines and Mexico, walked the Camino de Santiago across northern Spain, trekked to Machu Picchu on foot, hiked up volcanoes in Guatemala, enrolled in an post-baccalaureate computer science program, started a business with my husband, and more. Ask me about my experiences!
